bibliography.title: Decoupling The "What" and "Where" With Polar Coordinate Positional Embedding

abstract_sentences.text: The attention mechanism in a Transformer architecture matches key to query based on both content—the what—and position in a sequence—the where.

evidence.anchor: matches key to query based on both content and position

abstract_sentences.text: We present an analysis indicating that what and where are entangled in the popular Rotary Position Embedding (RoPE).

evidence.anchor: what and where are entangled in the popular Rotary Position Embedding

abstract_sentences.text: This entanglement can impair performance particularly when decisions require independent matches on these two factors.

evidence.anchor: entanglement can impair performance particularly when decisions require independent matches

abstract_sentences.text: We propose an improvement to RoPE, which we call Polar Coordinate Position Embedding or PoPE, that eliminates the what-where confound.

evidence.anchor: propose an improvement to RoPE that eliminates the what-where confound

abstract_sentences.text: PoPE is far superior on a diagnostic task requiring indexing solely by position or by content.

evidence.anchor: far superior on a diagnostic task requiring indexing solely by position or by content

abstract_sentences.text: On autoregressive sequence modeling in music, genomic, and natural language domains, Transformers using PoPE as the positional encoding scheme outperform baselines using RoPE with respect to evaluation loss (perplexity) and downstream task performance.

evidence.anchor: music, genomic, and natural language domains outperform baselines using RoPE

abstract_sentences.text: On language modeling, these gains persist across model scale, from 124M to 774M parameters.

evidence.anchor: gains persist across model scale, from 124M to 774M parameters

abstract_sentences.text: Crucially, PoPE shows strong zero-shot length extrapolation capabilities compared not only to RoPE but even a method designed for extrapolation, YaRN, which requires additional fine tuning and frequency interpolation.

evidence.anchor: strong zero-shot length extrapolation capabilities compared to RoPE and YaRN
prehistory of deep learning and sequential or position-coded data
RNNs have approximate translation equivariance; slot-based representations do not share this property
translation and permutation invariant subject to causal attention boundaries
key-query match can be characterized as a conjunction of a what match and a where match

final_judgment.single_storyline: RoPE 的 key/query-dependent phase interaction 把 what 与 where 耦合；PoPE 用逐元素 softplus magnitude 与仅由相对位置决定的 phase 删除该交互，并用机制诊断、跨域 NLL/PPL、下游任务和长度外推检验这一偏置。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 正文保留 Eq. (2)/(5) 的机制差异、PoPE/RoPE 配对控制、Tables 1–6、三种模型规模、Figure 2 外推曲线、Table 5 主消融和工程成本方向。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: 附录承载 RoPE 完整推导、FLOPs、数据集与训练细节、额外 positional-encoding 基线及 253M 频率/δ 可视化；A/B 提高复现粒度，C/D 降低主文对完整 baseline 与机制诊断的自足性。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 先把 what–where confound 化为 Eq. (2) 的单一 interaction term，再以 Eq. (5) 删除它；随后用 Indirect Indexing 的大幅配对差异，再扩展到真实域和 Figure 2。
final_judgment.largest_gap: 外推图与跨域单点结果缺少 seed、误差、完整数值和 runtime；Table 6 的任务级回退被 Avg 聚合，Table 5 与 Figure 3 还存在 caption 范围不一致。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 机制性位置编码主张应先用能单独要求该机制的最小诊断任务，再用匹配控制的跨域结果与组件/替代基线消融回收同一机制，并在正文列出任务级异质性和成本。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于机制可程序化隔离、组件可替换且有配对编码对照的模型论文；只有无配对应用 benchmark 时，性能差异不能直接归因于交互项删除。
